responsibility: Declares the HP-UX 10-specific `-threads` driver option for the PA port. Its role is to expose the option-table entry consumed by the HP-UX 10 CPP, library, and thread-model specs in `pa-hpux10.h`, where it triggers `_REENTRANT`/thread predefines and selection of the DCE thread runtime libraries.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 10 option-table fragment: unlike pa-hpux10.h, which implements the HP-UX 10 target behavior and specs, this file only contributes the single driver option declaration `threads` that those specs test to enable DCE-thread predefines, libraries, and thread-model reporting.
